tools.spare.title: Spare part inquiry
tools.spare.hint: A broken cover, a gear, a bracket. A printer models the part from photos and measurements.
spare.lead: Photograph the part, measure it and tell us what it is for. Printers who also model get the inquiry and send you a quote.
spare.honest: To be straight: an exact working part does not appear automatically from one photo. A person makes the model from photos and measurements, often with one test print. The better your input, the faster and cheaper it gets.
spare.photos.hint: 1 to 5 photos: the whole part from several sides, the damage in detail and where it belongs. A ruler or a coin in the picture helps.
spare.what.ph: e.g. battery cover of a Philips remote, the latch broke off
spare.use: What it does and how it is stressed
spare.use.ph: e.g. holds a fridge shelf, pulled out now and then
spare.dims.hint: roughly is fine, a caliper is better
spare.original: I can send or show the original part (even broken) to the printer
spare.load: How much load the part takes
spare.load.none.hint: a cover, a cap, a trim
spare.load.light.hint: a handle, a knob, a cable clip
spare.load.medium.hint: a hinge, a hook, a shelf bracket
spare.load.heavy.hint: bears weight, rotates, pressure, heat; the printer judges whether printing suits it
spare.env.heat: in heat (car, near an engine, dishwasher)
spare.material.unknown: I don't know, the printer advises
spare.promise: It is free and non-binding. You see quotes with the price of modelling and printing on one page and choose.
spare.failed: The inquiry could not be sent. Check the fields and try again.
spare.badge: Spare part: there is no model yet, the quote includes modelling.
check.page.lead: Upload a model and we tell you what we can check reliably and what it means for printing.
check.page.pick: Choose a file or drop it here
check.page.bad_format: We cannot read this file type. Supported: :f.
check.page.too_big: The file is larger than :max MB.
check.page.failed: The file could not be processed. Try saving it again as STL or 3MF.
check.page.go: Get the price and request printing
check.title: Model check
check.head.error: We found errors that will probably spoil the print
check.head.ok: The model is fine in everything we can check
check.disclaimer: The check does not guarantee the model will print well. Overhangs, wall strength and accuracy depend on the printer, material and orientation; a printer judges those.
check.units_tiny.impact: It was probably saved in metres or inches instead of millimetres. This small it cannot be printed; scale it up with the size slider or save it again in millimetres.
check.units_huge.impact: That is over two metres, most likely wrong units. Scale it down with the size slider or save it again in millimetres.
check.very_small.impact: An ordinary filament printer loses details below about 0.5 mm. Consider resin printing or a bigger scale.
check.exceeds_bed: The model (:size) does not fit an ordinary printer (:bed)
check.exceeds_bed.impact: Only a printer with a bigger machine can make it, or it gets split into parts and glued. Expect a higher price and a longer wait.
check.too_thin: The model is only :t mm thin in one direction
check.too_thin.impact: That is less than two lines of an ordinary nozzle. The print will be fragile or will not form at all. Thicken the model to 1 mm at least.
check.not_watertight: The mesh is not closed (it has holes or loose edges)
check.not_watertight.impact: The slicer then has to guess what is inside and what is outside: parts may go missing or get filled. Repair the model (for example with "repair" in a slicer or in the program it came from).
check.flipped_normals: Some faces are turned inside out
check.flipped_normals.impact: The printer may skip such a place or fill a cavity. Fix the face orientation (normals) in the modelling program.
check.multiple_shells: The model consists of :n separate bodies
check.multiple_shells.impact: If that is intended (several parts on one plate), it is fine. If it should be one piece, the bodies may not fuse and the part falls apart.
check.heavy_mesh.impact: It can be printed, but processing will be slow and some programs will not open it. Simplifying the mesh usually does not hurt print quality.
check.very_coarse: The model is very coarse (:n triangles)
check.very_coarse.impact: Round shapes will look faceted on the print. If that is not intended, export the model at a finer resolution.

param.vase.tip: A printed vase may not be watertight: microscopic gaps can remain between layers. For cut flowers put a glass inside or have the printer seal it with varnish. A pot with drainage lets water through on purpose, hence the saucer.

param.flag.invert.hint: Uploaded pictures only: what is light in the picture gets raised.
param.stamp.lead: Type a text or upload a motif. We mirror the stamp for you; switch the preview to the imprint to see what it leaves.
param.stamp.tip: Made for clay, polymer clay and other modelling compounds. A printed stamp is not suited to ink and paper, the surface is too hard. The handle prints separately and is glued on.

param.error.svg_outlines_only: The SVG has only outlines without fills; no 3D shape comes from those. Convert strokes to paths and fill them in your drawing program.
param.error.svg_empty: We found no filled shape in the SVG.
param.error.image_unreadable: The picture could not be read. Use PNG or JPG.
param.error.image_blank: The picture is almost one colour (the motif is :n%). We need a dark motif on a light background; try "Swap light and dark".
param.error.image_is_photo: This looks like a photograph with smooth shades. For photos use the Relief and lithophane tool; this one is for two-colour logos and silhouettes.
param.error.image_too_noisy: The picture fell apart into :n tiny islands (noise, texture, JPEG artefacts). Use a clean version of the logo, ideally SVG or PNG.
param.error.vase_too_narrow: At its narrowest there would be no room inside. Use a bigger diameter or a thinner wall.
param.error.qr_bad_text: Enter a link or a text of 4 to 300 characters.
param.error.qr_too_dense: At this size the modules would be under 0.9 mm and a printer cannot print them legibly. Make the code :n mm at least, or shorten the link.
param.error.qr_unreadable: The read-back check of the design failed. Make the code bigger or shorten the link.
calc.tip.vase: It prints floor down without supports. The print may not be watertight; put a glass inside or ask the printer to seal it.
calc.tip.logo: It prints lying flat without supports. A motif in another colour comes from a filament swap.
calc.tip.stamp: The stamp and the handle print side by side; the handle is glued on with superglue (not included).
calc.tip.qr: Print a light plate and a dark code (filament swap after the last plate layer). Test the code with a phone before printing more pieces.
